ValidationRule.description: QCC: Don't change Recovery details when Recovery is in progress and finalised.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.VR_Donot_changeRecoverydetailsonceAppro__c, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Connect', NOT(ISCHANGED(Status__c)), Text(Status__c) <> 'Open', Text(Status__c) <> 'Awaiting Approval', Text(Type__c) <> 'Bag Replacement', OR( PRIORVALUE(Value__c) <> Value__c,PRIORVALUE(Amount__c) <> Amount__c,Text(PRIORVALUE(Type__c)) <> Text(Type__c), Text(PRIORVALUE(Stage__c)) <> Text(Stage__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Type or Amount or Value or Stage can't be changed.
